NO background, floor, shadow, haze, writing, numbers, grid, labels, watermark, motion marks, decorations or hearts. Keep every tail and ear entirely inside its cell. assembly.layout: Extract complete high-alpha connected silhouettes with horizontal column overscan, sort chronological row-major, pack four columns. Minimum384px cells; enlarge each shared cell axis when required to retain complete source silhouettes. No anatomy or expressions painted.
assembly.selection: All accepted source indices retained in row-major order. Lift slot15 selects source0 again as the generated neutral before the separate appended canonical idle. Runtime lift slot0 is actual idle; appended slot16 is actual idle.
assembly.sleepy: Reject original output: shortened body and detached imported fragments12px/5px. Use the precise face-only calm-sheet edit instead: first4 yawn drawings once, source4..11 are8 closed-eye loop poses. Requested16 in rejected draft but actual output12; actual layout always inspected.
assembly.roll: Reject first output and background-extraction edit: both retain visible gray halo. Use fresh clean redraw with transparent gaps; no programmatic background/anatomy painting.
assembly.import: Each packed cell samples to128px wide using Qt.FastTransformation before component bounds, matching the existing pet importer. One scale per bank: horizontal62/reference head span; lift vertical82/neutral full height, other banks uniform head-span scale. Held head span measured only in upper40% to exclude a high tail. Folded entry families use final upright held drawing as calibration and a silhouette-center track referenced to that head.
assembly.anchors: Original canvas padded32px above, resulting192x144. Seated ground130, canonical crown48, held crown16. Lift crowns48,48,46,42,34,24,18,16. Main release crowns18,24,34,48,48,51,48,48. Pose-family bridge tops interpolate from supported ground to held crown using authored joint changes. Initial user-visible frame is preserved and an entry translation fades to zero; no crossfading or joint interpolation.
assembly.timing: 8x50ms normal lift,2.4s held loops. Awake mood stages0-3s excited,3-10s calm,10-20s unimpressed,20+s sleepy. Two4x100ms mood bridges; yawn150/150/200/150ms once. Release uses live snapshot, drawn face/closing bridge and700ms authored landing. Nap release reverses closed-eye side entry. Mid-entry release retraces visited drawings then existing recovery. Re-grab retraces release and completes remaining lift. Mood clock pauses during release and retracing, retaining expression phase.
assembly.compatibility: All427 pre-pickup atlas drawings compare byte-for-byte after cropping32px top padding; all32 original clip definitions unchanged. Saved visible origin adds/subtracts QPoint40,32. Tray crops central112x112 at40,32. Legacy catalogs omit empty top padding.
assembly.verification: Every100 imported carry source slots passes connected-fragment/head-scale/bounds checks and visual source review. Native full mood/release/entry measurements in pickup-native.json. Mixed-DPI physical monitor transfer and long-session resource behavior remain untested.
